notes.title: v4.0.9
notes.content: Potential fix for a reported crash on Windows 11.

notes.title: v4.0.8
notes.content:
- New 64-bit binaries for improved performance on modern CPUs.
- Removed support for 32-bit OS.
- Other minor performance and stability updates.

notes.title: v4.0.7
notes.content: - Fixed issue with custom cards not saving immediately after changing the number of drinks.

notes.title: v4.0.6: Custom cards fix
notes.content: - Fixed crash when using % signs in custom cards.

notes.title: v4.0.1
notes.content:
- Added support for ultra-wide screens.
- Performance and stability update.

notes.title: v3.5.2
notes.content: We did some minor optimizations with textures to take up less disk space.

notes.title: v3.5.0
notes.content: As we are proud Croatians, we decided that we should add a new Croatian fan character to support our team and lead them victory in the World Cup!

notes.title: v3.4.5
notes.content: We removed that weird black screen and put our logo back in there. We're not incompetent, we swear.

notes.title: v3.4.4
notes.content: This time we actually did a bit more than just fixing another fullscreen-switch bug! We optimized some textures to make the game run smoother. Now you can run the game on a toaster. Probably.

notes.title: v3.4.3
notes.content: We fixed a seemingly random crash (it was happening randomly, but not caused by random circumstances!) Being a programmer is like being the detective in a crime movie where you are also the murderer.

notes.title: v3.4.2
notes.content: It's always a battle. What new bugs does the Windows 10 Update bring? What drivers will break down this time? What network adapters will go haywire? What settings will be moved around to confuse people even more? Well, we know that the fullscreen/windowed bug wasn't fixed fully, but this time we did it right.

notes.title: v3.4.1
notes.content: As technology goes forward, Windows 10 Update ironically seems to go backward. This update is to (attempt) fixing some issues introduced by the new Windows 10 Update 1803. We also fixed a bug in the fullscreen / windowed mode option, because who wants to play in windowed mode?

notes.title: v3.3.6
notes.content: We often update our code base to improve the game, fix bugs and add news bugs for all platforms. The Steam version just naturally benefits from that. Why the sudden jump to v3.3.6 you ask? It's definitely on purpose, because we can and in no way a silly mistake on our end that we noticed once it was too late.
Sometimes we like to drink, too. And then bugs happen. Like the weird behavior of the fullscreen button.

notes.title: v3.2.5
notes.content: We fixed some engine issues. No, the screen was really stuttering, it wasn't just the alcohol.

notes.title: v3.2.5
notes.content: We fixed some engine issues. No, the screen was really stuttering, it wasn't just the alcohol.

notes.title: v3.2.2
notes.content: Fixed a minor bug that would remove some challenges from the game entirely when "Truth" fields are active (and therefore making the achievement "Showmanshi(t)p" impossible). Truth be told, it's not worth if you miss out on content!

notes.content: Fixed a minor bug that would remove some challenges from the game entirely when "Truth" fields are active (and therefore making the achievement "Showmanshi(t)p" impossible). Truth be told, it's not worth if you miss out on content!

notes.title: New in v3.2.1
notes.content:
- Upgraded engine for multi-core processing to improve smoothness everywhere.
- Potentially fixed a nasty bug with custom cards that would go all Grinch mode on the game and take the fun away. :(
